shortDescription: BSF HCM & ASI Steno Answer Key 2026 is now available for the 1752-post recruitment exam conducted from 01 to 03 September 2026.
content:
Border Security Force (BSF) has released the BSF HCM & ASI Steno Answer Key 2026 for the recruitment of Assistant Sub Inspector (ASI) Stenographer and Head Constable (HC) Ministerial posts. The written examination was held on 01 – 03 September 2026.

Candidates can access the official answer key and download the linked notice PDF through the official BSF / digialm portal and compare their responses carefully.

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date: 09 June 2024
  • Online Apply Last Date: 08 July 2024
  • Last Date for fee payment: 08 July 2024
  • Written exam date: 01 – 03 September 2026
  • Admit card: 19 August 2026
  • Answer key: 10 September 2026 Available Now
  • Result date: Will Be Updated Here Soon

Vacancy Details

  • ASI Stenographer: 256 posts
  • HC Ministerial: 1496 posts

Application Fee
